title: host.get
description: Retrieve hosts according to the given parameters.

groupids.description: Return only hosts that belong to the given groups.

dserviceids.description: Return only hosts that are related to the given discovered services.

graphids.description: Return only hosts that have the given graphs.

hostids.description: Return only hosts with the given host IDs.

httptestids.description: Return only hosts that have the given web checks.

interfaceids.description: Return only hosts that use the given interfaces.

itemids.description: Return only hosts that have the given items.

maintenanceids.description: Return only hosts that are affected by the given maintenances.

proxyids.description: Return only hosts that are monitored by the given proxies.

proxy_groupids.description: Return only hosts that are monitored by the given proxy groups.

templateids.description: Return only hosts that are linked to the given templates.

triggerids.description: Return only hosts that have the given triggers.

with_items.description: Return only hosts that have items. Overrides the with_monitored_items and with_simple_graph_items parameters.

with_item_prototypes.description: Return only hosts that have item prototypes. Overrides the with_simple_graph_item_prototypes parameter.

with_simple_graph_item_prototypes.description: Return only hosts that have item prototypes, which are enabled for creation and have numeric type of information.

with_graphs.description: Return only hosts that have graphs.

with_graph_prototypes.description: Return only hosts that have graph prototypes.

with_httptests.description: Return only hosts that have web checks. Overrides the with_monitored_httptests parameter.

with_monitored_httptests.description: Return only hosts that have enabled web checks.

with_monitored_items.description: Return only hosts that have enabled items. Overrides the with_simple_graph_items parameter.

with_monitored_triggers.description: Return only hosts that have enabled triggers. All of the items used in the trigger must also be enabled.

with_simple_graph_items.description: Return only hosts that have items with numeric type of information.

with_triggers.description: Return only hosts that have triggers. Overrides the with_monitored_triggers parameter.

withProblemsSuppressed.description: If set to true return only hosts with suppressed problems.

evaltype.description: Tag evaluation method. Possible values: 0 - (default) And/Or; 2 - Or.

severities.description: Return hosts that have only problems with given severities. Applies only if problem object is trigger.

tags.description: Return only hosts with the given tags. Format: [{"tag": "<tag>", "value": "<value>", "operator": "<operator>"}, ...]. An empty array returns all hosts.

operator.description: Possible values: 0 - (default) Contains; 1 - Equals; 2 - Does not contain; 3 - Does not equal; 4 - Exists; 5 - Does not exist.

inheritedTags.description: Return hosts that have given tags also in all of their linked templates. Possible values: true - linked templates must also have given tags; false - (default) linked template tags are ignored.

selectDiscoveries.description: Return a discoveries property with host low-level discovery rules. Supports count.

selectDiscoveryRule.description: Return a discoveryRule property with the low-level discovery rule that created the host (from host prototype in VMware monitoring).

selectGraphs.description: Return a graphs property with host graphs. Supports count.

selectHostDiscovery.description: Return a hostDiscovery property with host discovery object data. Links a discovered host to a host prototype or a host prototype to an LLD rule; contains host, hostid, parent_hostid, parent_itemid, lastcheck, status, ts_delete, ts_disable, disable_source.

selectHostGroups.description: Return a hostgroups property with host groups data that the host belongs to.

selectHttpTests.description: Return an httpTests property with host web scenarios. Supports count.

selectInterfaces.description: Return an interfaces property with host interfaces. Supports count.

selectInventory.description: Return an inventory property with host inventory data.

selectItems.description: Return an items property with host items. Supports count.

selectMacros.description: Return a macros property with host macros.

selectParentTemplates.description: Return a parentTemplates property with templates that the host is linked to. In addition to Template object fields, contains link_type (integer): 0 - (default) manually linked; 1 - automatically linked by LLD. Supports count.

selectDashboards.description: Return a dashboards property. Supports count.

selectTags.description: Return a tags property with host tags.

selectInheritedTags.description: Return an inheritedTags property with tags that are on all templates which are linked to the host.

selectTriggers.description: Return a triggers property with host triggers. Supports count.

selectValueMaps.description: Return a valuemaps property with host value maps.

selectGroups.description: Deprecated, use selectHostGroups instead. Return a groups property with host groups data that the host belongs to.

filter.description: Return only those results that exactly match the given filter. Accepts an object, where the keys are property names, and the values are either a single value or an array of values to match against. Does not support properties of text data type. Supports additional properties: Host interface properties.

limitSelects.description: Limits the number of records returned by subselects. Applies to: selectParentTemplates (sorted by host), selectInterfaces, selectItems (sorted by name), selectDiscoveries (sorted by name), selectTriggers (sorted by description), selectGraphs (sorted by name), selectDashboards (sorted by name).

search.description: Return results that match the given pattern (case-insensitive). Accepts an object, where the keys are property names, and the values are strings to search for. If no additional options are given, this will perform a LIKE "%...%" search. Supports only properties of string and text data type. Supports additional properties: Host interface properties.

searchInventory.description: Return hosts that have inventory data that match the given pattern (case-insensitive). Accepts an object, where the keys are property names, and the values are strings to search for. If no additional options are given, this will perform a LIKE "%...%" search. Supports only properties of string and text data type.

sortfield.description: Sort the result by the given properties. Possible values: hostid, host, name, status.

countOutput.description: Return the number of records in the result instead of the actual data.

editable.description: If set to true, return only objects that the user has write permissions to. Default: false.

excludeSearch.description: Return results that do not match the criteria given in the search parameter.

limit.description: Limit the number of records returned.

output.description: Object properties to be returned. Default: extend.

preservekeys.description: Use IDs as keys in the resulting array.

searchByAny.description: If true, return results that match any of the criteria given in the filter or search parameter. Default: false.

searchWildcardsEnabled.description: If true, enables the use of '*' as a wildcard character. Default: false.

sortorder.description: Order of sorting. ASC or DESC.

startSearch.description: The search parameter will compare the beginning of fields. Ignored if searchWildcardsEnabled is set.
